Class LessonExperience

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonExperience
public final class LessonExperience extends Object

Title: LessonExperience

Description: An immutable record of one attempt to use an existing lesson. The Contributor experience story supplies what was done, how, elapsed time, and effort by team member. Separate records preserve earlier attempts for future analysis. Minutes and two decimal places are implementation choices, not course requirements.

Author:
Huichang Zhang

  • Constructor Details

    • LessonExperience

      public LessonExperience(long id, int lessonId, String contributor, String whatDone, String howDone, BigDecimal elapsedMinutes, String memberEffort)
      Validates an attempt before storage and when constructing a saved snapshot.
      Parameters:
      id - generated ID, or zero for a new attempt
      lessonId - positive ID of the existing lesson
      contributor - signed-in contributor name
      whatDone - activity performed; required, maximum 10,000 characters
      howDone - procedure followed; required, maximum 10,000 characters
      elapsedMinutes - positive elapsed minutes with at most two decimal places
      memberEffort - lines in the form Member name: minutes
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any input violates the field rules

  • Method Details

    • parseMinutes

      public static BigDecimal parseMinutes(String field, String value, boolean allowZero)
      Parses decimal minutes consistently for the GUI and database boundary.
      Parameters:
      field - field name included in an actionable error
      value - decimal text; no exponent notation
      allowZero - whether a member may report zero working minutes
      Returns:
      minutes fitting the database's DECIMAL(12,2) column
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for missing, malformed, negative, or oversized values
